sentences.text: Lab Report: Model comparison on benchmarks
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
The learning rate was set to 0.01 with the Adam optimizer.
Each experiment was repeated 5 times with different random seeds.
Figure 1 shows the test accuracy during training.
From epoch 3 to epoch 20, the test accuracy of ResNet-18 improves by a relative about 40%.
From epoch 5 to epoch 15, the test accuracy of ResNet-18 improves by a relative 70.5%.
Figure 2 shows the validation accuracy during training.
Baseline outperforms EfficientNet by 15.7 percentage points at epoch 4.
As shown in Figure 2, CNN attains a validation accuracy of 61.1% at epoch 13.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
